node.doctext:

my $line = <>; print "This is what line looks like $line \n"; #while ($line = !<>) { chomp($line); print "This is what line looks like $line \n"; my @items = (split /> line 1. Invalid conversion in printf: "%20R" at ./XML_parse line 19, <> line 1.
